text:
Ravi: hi folks, new oncall this week. quick setup check: who owns PagerDuty invites + service mappings?
Elena: welcome! @oncall-infra owns the PD org but eng-identity handles SSO role mapping. ping me if invite doesn't show up.
Ravi: I got an invite but no services listed. only "Global" team.
Priya: that usually means the team tags weren't added to your profile. @Elena can add 'sre-apps' tag.
Elena: done. give it 5m and refresh PD.
Ravi: still empty.
oncall-bot: reminder: complete MFA and link device for PagerDuty within 24h: https://pd.redwood/setup
Liam: if PD looks wrong after 10m, open a slack ticket to #eng-identity with your employee id + screenshot. they usually fix mapping same day.
Ravi: filing ticket now. also, any recommended runbooks to skim first?
Priya: skim 'api-503-response', 'db-failover', 'traffic-surge'. prioritize ones for services you support.
Tiffany: practice runs help a lot. we run a mini-drill on Wednesdays 14:00 in staging. join as shadow before taking live pages.
Ravi: nice. how strict are severity levels? i.e., sev1 vs sev2 triage differences?
Liam: sev1 = customer impact + major outage (call the oncall-lead and execs), start war-room channel. sev2 = degraded but partial. follow runbooks and escalate to service owner if not resolved in 30 minutes.
Priya: tip: annotate the alert with steps you've tried. it speeds up handoffs.
Ravi: what's our handoff format?
Elena: we use /handoff in #eng-oncall with a short list. example:
```
/handoff
Shift: Ravi -> Priya
Incidents: API-503 (mitigated)
Action: failed cache node replaced, monitoring OK
Followup: schedule cache compaction tomorrow
```
Ravi: sweet. one more: where are sensitive runbooks (secrets/rotate keys)?
Priya: sensitive ops are in the vault-linked docs. link: https://docs.redwood.internal/oncall/secure-runbooks (access controlled). request view via access form.
oncall-bot: scheduled event: staging-mini-drill Wednesday 14:00 (auto-invite sent).
Tiffany: if you want a pairing session, DM me and I'll walk you through db-failover in staging this week.
Ravi: will do, thanks everyone. i'll update the ticket once PD is fixed and sign up for the drill. :pray:
